about.name: about
about.title: About Minecraft Survivor
about.body:
Minecraft Survivor is a game based on the fifty-season reality TV show "Survivor", but set in Minecraft. While trying to survive on an unforgiving island, castaways must use their strategic, social, and physical skills to outwit, outplay, and outlast the 17 people around them to become the Sole Survivor.

The game starts off in a tribe phase, where players are broken up into tribes to compete for immunity. The tribe(s) that lose those challenges must then vote for somebody to be removed from their tribe and eliminated from the game. At around the halfway point in the game, the tribes merge into one, and individuals compete for immunity from the vote, where anyone else can be voted out at any time. This continues until there are 2-3 players left, where those final players must then present their case to a jury of the people they have voted out. The jury then votes for the winner of the game, or the Sole Survivor.

The game expects and encourages building relationships, betraying allies, and lying to further one's game, but be careful not to piss off too many people, otherwise they won't vote for you to become the Sole Survivor! Use all the skills you have at your disposal to get to the end, but know that everyone else will be doing the same thing.

list.name: list
list.desc: List any reminders that you are currently set to receive.

add.name: set
add.desc: Set a timed reminder to receive before a session. Can optionally repeat. Sent via Discord DM.

args.hours: How many hours before the session (0-23, default 0). Added onto minutes.
args.minutes: How many minutes before the session (0-59, default 0). Added onto hours.
args.name: (Optional) Name of the reminder.
args.week: Which week to send this reminder (1-15). Alternatively, leave empty to send before every week!

remove.name: remove
remove.desc: Shows a list of your current reminders. Choose which one to remove
